name: doodle-play
description: space — 浏览器涂鸦画布加彩蛋按钮实验间
interaction: A blank browser canvas invites free-form doodling with playful brushes and colors. Scattered among the toolbar are disguised easter egg buttons—press them to trigger surprise effects like gravity mode, rainbow trails, or canvas-shaking animations. Each discovery unlocks a new way to transform your sketch into living art.
